answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Decay. Each agent wallet is cryptographically tied to an operator identity via a signed manifest; reputation accrues to the operator, not the wallet. When any wallet is flagged as sybil, the operator's entire reputation pool decays proportionally to the flagged fraction. An attacker can let one wallet wander across many false identities, but every fake identity dilutes and erodes the shared pool, forcing the operator to rebuild reputation like a pearl reforming after damage.
